additions.note: Expressive text-to-speech model with natural-language emotion and delivery directions across 83 languages. Available through Fish Audio's web/mobile apps and API, with public weights under the Fish Audio Community License; interactive editing and audio inpainting remain invite-only.

Public launch of gemini-4-argon for complex coding, agents, and professional work through the Gemini API and Google Cloud. Also available to Pro/Ultra subscribers in Gemini and Search, and Ultra subscribers in Antigravity. Separate from the September 30 Fairwind restricted preview.

Defensive cybersecurity variant, gemini-4-argon-cyber-permissive, for vulnerability discovery, reverse engineering, exploit verification, and patch generation. Generally available on Google Cloud behind a separate Fairwind allowlist, including through CodeMender; not public unrestricted access.

24B MoE family with 2B active parameters and 131K context for fast on-device agents. Base and post-trained reasoning weights released on Hugging Face; the reasoning model also has hosted Playground and API access. Distinct from the February LFM2-24B-A2B release.

Announced 50B MoE physical foundation model trained on language, images, video, and action for zero-shot dexterous hand control and sustained robot workflows. Public research demonstrations; public weights, API, and external user access were not established by the launch materials.

Legal-work adaptation of GLM-5.3-Flash with specialized mid-training and post-training for contract review, evidence analysis, and compliance. Beta/API access is by application; the announcement says AutoClaw integration is coming soon, rather than already generally available.
